jei.jaymospowers.chopping.ground: Or set the log down anywhere and use an axe on its top: a plank fewer.
jei.jaymospowers.chopping_block: Set a log down, sneak and use an axe on its top to cut it into a chopping block of that wood. Stand logs on it (up to 16; sneak for all you hold), then use an axe on it: each log takes a few blows (fewer with a better axe) and splits into a plank more than it would on the ground, sometimes with sawdust. An empty hand takes the logs back.
jei.jaymospowers.chopping.how: Stand logs on the block, then use an axe on it: %s blows a log with flint or stone, %s with copper, %s with iron or better.
jei.jaymospowers.chopping.yield: Splits into %s, %s or %s planks by the same axes, sometimes with sawdust.
